sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The "🗂 Sidebar as tables" button is now off by default: the two new views (WIP.1, WIP.2) show the same information beside the page's own data. Turn it back on with "'Sidebar as tables' button" in ⚙️ Settings; if you had it on because it was the default, it is switched off once.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: After the page's own button (Tracks, Releases, Artist RGs, …) a "Sidebar" heading now follows the Credits or Relationships section (on a page without one: right above the table). It shows the sidebar's information, labels, release events, external links and tags as small read-only cards: facts as name → value lines side by side, links as chips grouped by kind, tags as pills with their votes. Each card closes on its own. Nothing is loaded. Settings: "Sidebar facts below Credits/Relationships" (on) and "… start the 'Sidebar' section closed" (off).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The Credits and Relationships views (and the place, area and instrument pages) now end with the sidebar's groups as tables of their own: "Sidebar: Release information", "Sidebar: Additional details", "Sidebar: Labels", "Sidebar: Release events", "Sidebar: External links", "Sidebar: Tags". They share the heading's filter and can be sorted and filtered like the relationship tables. A sidebar link that is already a relationship row is left out. Settings: "Sidebar tables in the Credits/Relationships view", "… skip links already in a relationship table", "… include external links", "… include tags" (all on).
